name: Ranger: a Quiver aura stays active when a back-sheathed bow is equipped (#7302)
contract: #7302 The Quiver model is the aura's spell visual (Skirmisher's Quiver 801069, SpellVisual 645, state kit 1145 attaches the quiver model at attachment 28). The report: with a bow that sheathes on the back, such as Old Bow 484322 (sheath 4; Worn Shortbow 2504 has sheath 0), the quiver model disappears. 801069 has EquippedItemClass -1, AuraInterruptFlags 0 and an unlimited duration, so the server must keep the aura through ranged weapon changes; the missing model is then drawn, or not, by the client. Expected: the aura 801069 is active after casting it with Worn Shortbow, after equipping Old Bow, after switching back to Worn Shortbow and after equipping Old Bow again.

steps.label: Equip Worn Shortbow (sheath 0) in the ranged slot
The Quiver aura is active with Worn Shortbow
Equip Old Bow (sheath 4, worn on the back)
The Quiver aura stays active with Old Bow
The Quiver aura stays active after switching back
The Quiver aura stays active with Old Bow equipped again
